title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2025 DEC)
summary: A community-curated list of feature requests and application ideas for Dynamics 365 Business Central spanning multiple modules, including agent and copilot capabilities, financial management, sales, inventory, manufacturing, and administration. The post organizes hundreds of suggestions by functional area to guide development priorities.
key_points: Multiple feature categories are covered including copilot agents, data migration, financial management, and sustainability
Community members contribute specific improvement ideas with their names listed for each suggestion
Requests span core modules like sales, purchasing, inventory, and manufacturing, plus emerging areas like Shopify integration
Many suggestions address existing functionality gaps such as serial number handling, multi-currency support, and journal enhancements
The list includes infrastructure improvements like query builders, performance profilers, and email account management

quotes.text: Would any of these ideas improve Business Central? Here is a list of some of them.
quotes.why_it_matters: Frames the entire post as a community-driven innovation discussion about potential product improvements
